mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100k monthly growth indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth > 100k, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 1.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases real discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 0.3% MoM) and stable interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates unaccommodated inflation that pressures corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion phases with housing starts above 700k (HOUST > 700k), strong consumer demand supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with HOUST > 700k during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% indicates a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% monthly growth reflects strong consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with RSAFS growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) and GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.5%) signal economic contraction that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% annualized, it triggers anticipated Federal Reserve rate hikes that increase real borrowing costs and depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (annualized), or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.
